verdict.rationale: Databricks documents its own Free Edition, a no-cost workspace for experimenting with data and AI, and a free trial, so a free sandbox exists. Databricks Connect lets engineers develop and debug from a local IDE, but the code still runs on Databricks compute rather than a local engine or emulator. Free Edition is positioned for students and hobbyists, not as a dev tier that feeds production pipelines. Missing for 10: a local engine or emulator for offline transformation development, documented use of Free Edition as a pre-production dev loop with a promotion path, evidence the loop is fast, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
